full_parent_exercise_HTML_context:
Exercise 0.5b — Medium: Separate a supremum from a limit superior

For $a_t=(-1)^t+1/(t+1)$, $t\ge0$, compute $\sup_ta_t$, $\inf_ta_t$, $\limsup_ta_t$ and $\liminf_ta_t$. Which bounds are attained, and does the sequence converge?

Review: Suprema, infima and bounds

Show hint

Split into even and odd indices. A limit superior ignores any fixed finite beginning.

Show worked solution

Even indices: $a_{2k}=1+1/(2k+1)$ decreases from $2$ towards $1$. Hence the supremum of the entire sequence is $2$, attained at $t=0$.

Odd indices: $a_{2k+1}=-1+1/(2k+2)$ is always above $-1$ and decreases towards it. The infimum is $-1$, never attained.

Tails: every tail still contains infinitely many even and odd indices. Their limiting upper and lower values are $1$ and $-1$, respectively, so $\limsup a_t=1$ and $\liminf a_t=-1$.

Convergence check: since the two tail limits differ, the sequence has no single limit. The isolated initial value $2$ affects the supremum but not the limit superior.

full_public_theorem_bodies.name: SafeLearning.CompleteFoundationsFinitePrefix23.printed_additive_sequence_even_and_odd_limits
full_public_theorem_bodies.full_statement_and_body:
theorem printed_additive_sequence_even_and_odd_limits :
    Tendsto (fun n => printedAdditiveSequence (2*n)) atTop (𝓝 (1 : ℝ)) ∧
    Tendsto (fun n => printedAdditiveSequence (2*n+1)) atTop (𝓝 (-1 : ℝ)) := by
  have he : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 2*n) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_atTop_mono (fun n => by simp only [id_eq]; omega) tendsto_id
  have ho : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 2*n+1) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_atTop_mono (fun n => by simp only [id_eq]; omega) tendsto_id
  have hz : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 1/((n : ℝ)+1)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [one_div,Function.comp_def] using
      tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp
        (tendsto_atTop_add_const_right atTop (1 : ℝ) tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)
  constructor
  · have h := (tendsto_const_nhds (x := (1 : ℝ))).add (hz.comp he)
    simpa [printedAdditiveSequence,Function.comp_def,pow_mul] using h
  · have h := (tendsto_const_nhds (x := (-1 : ℝ))).add (hz.comp ho)
    simpa [printedAdditiveSequence,Function.comp_def,pow_succ,pow_mul] using h

full_public_theorem_bodies.name: SafeLearning.CompleteFoundationsFinitePrefix23.any_extended_limsup_is_unchanged_by_removing_a_finite_beginning
full_public_theorem_bodies.full_statement_and_body:
theorem any_extended_limsup_is_unchanged_by_removing_a_finite_beginning
    (a : ℕ → EReal) (N : ℕ) :
    limsup (fun n => a (n+N)) atTop = limsup a atTop :=
  limsup_nat_add a N

full_public_theorem_bodies.name: SafeLearning.CompleteFoundationsFinitePrefix23.any_extended_limsup_is_unchanged_by_replacing_a_finite_beginning
full_public_theorem_bodies.full_statement_and_body:
theorem any_extended_limsup_is_unchanged_by_replacing_a_finite_beginning
    (a b : ℕ → EReal) (N : ℕ) (h : ∀ n ≥ N, a n = b n) :
    limsup a atTop = limsup b atTop := by
  apply limsup_congr
  exact eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨N,h⟩

full_public_theorem_bodies.name: SafeLearning.CompleteFoundationsFinitePrefix23.printed_additive_sequence_has_no_single_real_limit
full_public_theorem_bodies.full_statement_and_body:
theorem printed_additive_sequence_has_no_single_real_limit :
    ¬ ∃ l : ℝ, Tendsto printedAdditiveSequence atTop (𝓝 l) := by
  rintro ⟨l,hl⟩
  have he : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 2*n) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_atTop_mono (fun n => by simp only [id_eq]; omega) tendsto_id
  have ho : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 2*n+1) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_atTop_mono (fun n => by simp only [id_eq]; omega) tendsto_id
  have h1 : l = (1 : ℝ) := tendsto_nhds_unique (hl.comp he)
    printed_additive_sequence_even_and_odd_limits.1
  have h2 : l = (-1 : ℝ) := tendsto_nhds_unique (hl.comp ho)
    printed_additive_sequence_even_and_odd_limits.2
  linarith
